<store>
Name: Northpaw Dog Supply
Sells: Northpaw Dog Supply sells walking gear for dogs, including a front-clip no-pull harness, a 6 ft biothane leash, a 30 ft training long line and a rechargeable LED collar light. It also sells beds and blankets, namely a memory foam dog bed with a removable cover and a machine-washable fleece dog blanket.
Audience: Dog owners who walk and train their dogs, including those dealing with leash pulling or walking in low light, and who want a comfortable bed or blanket for their dog at home.
Tone: friendly
Never say: —
</store>

<topic>
Working title: Dog Walking Essentials for Beginners: What Gear You Actually Need
Search it targets: dog walking essentials
</topic>

<products>
  P1: Front-Clip No-Pull Harness (Harness)
    F1: The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness is a harness.
    F2: The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness is made by Northpaw.
    F3: The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness is available in sizes XS, S, M, L, and XL.
    F4: The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness has a leash ring on the chest that turns the dog sideways when it pulls.
    F5: The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness has four adjustment points.
    F6: The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness has a padded neoprene chest plate.
    F7: The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness has reflective stitching.
    F8: The Front-Clip No-Pull Harness fits a chest girth of 13–42 in across sizes XS to XL.
  P2: Biothane Leash, 6 ft (Leash)
    F9: The Biothane Leash is 6 ft long.
    F10: The Biothane Leash is made of coated webbing that does not absorb water or smell.
    F11: The Biothane Leash is 5/8 in wide.
    F12: The Biothane Leash has a brass snap hook.
    F13: The Biothane Leash can be wiped clean.
    F14: The Biothane Leash has a breaking strength of 600 lb.
    F15: The Biothane Leash is made by Northpaw.
  P3: Rechargeable LED Collar Light (Light)
    F16: The Rechargeable LED Collar Light clips onto any collar or harness.
    F17: The Rechargeable LED Collar Light has three modes: steady, slow flash, and fast flash.
    F18: The Rechargeable LED Collar Light is visible from about 1,000 ft.
    F19: The Rechargeable LED Collar Light charges via USB-C.
    F20: The Rechargeable LED Collar Light runs for 6 hours on steady mode.
    F21: The Rechargeable LED Collar Light is rated IPX7 waterproof.
    F22: The Rechargeable LED Collar Light is made by Northpaw.
    F23: The Rechargeable LED Collar Light is rechargeable.
  P4: Training Long Line, 30 ft (Leash) [related]
    F24: The Training Long Line is 30 ft long.
    F25: The Training Long Line is a leash.
    F26: The Training Long Line is made by Northpaw.
    F27: The Training Long Line is made of lightweight biothane.
    F28: The Training Long Line is intended for recall practice.
    F29: The Training Long Line has no handle loop.
    F30: The Training Long Line floats in water.
    F31: The Training Long Line has a stainless steel swivel clip.
</products>
